hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == */plan.md ]]; then spec_dir=$(dirname "$f"); spec_dir=$(dirname "$spec_dir"); cp "$f" "$spec_dir/plan.md" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; }

current_branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [[ "$current_branch" == feature/* ]]; then echo '{"systemMessage": "⚠️  You are on a feature branch. Create a phase branch first: .claude/scripts/create-feature-branch.sh <spec-id> <phase-desc>"}'; fi
